description: This file declares the OemLock class which implements the BnOemLock interface for OEM lock management, including methods to get lock status and set lock permissions, utilizing a transport channel and internal request/set methods.

classes.name: OemLock
classes.description: Implements the BnOemLock interface to manage OEM lock state, providing methods to query and modify OEM lock permissions.

methods.name: OemLock
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the OemLock with a reference to a transport channel.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the OEM lock.

methods.name: isOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by the carrier.

methods.name: isOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Checks if OEM unlock is allowed by the device.

methods.name: setOemUnlockAllowedByCarrier
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by the carrier.

methods.name: setOemUnlockAllowedByDevice
methods.description: Sets whether OEM unlock is allowed by the device.

methods.name: requestValue
methods.description: Internal method to request a boolean value for a specific OEM lock field.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Internal method to set a boolean value for a specific OEM lock field.
